build_td3_trainer: build a TD3 trainer with actor and critic networks using normalization data and reward options
create_td3_model_manager: create a TD3 model manager with custom actor and critic net builders and trainer parameters
build_td3_serving_module: build a TD3 serving module from a trained TD3 trainer and normalization data map
get_td3_reporter: get a TD3Reporter instance for logging TD3 training metrics and performance data
configure_td3_q_functions: configure TD3 to use one or two Q functions via the use_2_q_functions parameter
